name: gabriel-operator
description: Gabriel Operator skills for creating AI Personas from a Gabi token, plus workflows, Page Builder apps, team agents, pipelines, lists, todos, applications, asset libraries, embeds, and digital twin pages.

interface.longDescription: A skills-first Codex plugin for Gabriel Operator. persona-builder provisions a new AI Persona from a Gabi token (page, lists, pipeline, workflows, git, team agents). It also bundles workflow-builder, team-agents, page-builder, pipeline-builder, list-builder, todo-builder, application, digital-twin-page, digital-twin-embed, asset-library, and their nested action/component/node guides.
